title: Compose follow-up Outcome recording with evidence association
purpose: Make the existing record_outcome UoW call the separate Dataset association command over its already-locked authoritative source refs, completing production multi-evidence reachability without adding an endpoint or moving target derivation into Task & Follow-Up.
success_outcome: For a newly created Outcome, Task & Follow-Up passes the locked Outcome and authorized canonical refs to associate_follow_up_evidence before commit; matching eligible source candidates gain exactly one Outcome ref and event, unsupported/zero matches are safe no-ops, duplicate Outcome retry adds nothing, any association/audit/commit failure rolls back Task completion, Outcome, Outcome candidate, and enrichments, and public FT-012 behavior is unchanged.
anti_goals: Caller-selected candidate IDs, Task-owned association rules, new Outcome request/response fields, lifecycle/curator execution, background delivery, or historical reconciliation.
evidence_required: FT-014-AC-012 RED: after TASK-053 and before this wiring, record_outcome creates its own Outcome candidate but leaves every referenced photo/check-in/measurement candidate at one ref; GREEN: eligible candidates gain one typed Outcome ref inside the same UoW while unsupported/terminal/no-match controls stay unchanged; decisive comparison: exact refs/versions/events, duplicate/conflict, rollback/noise, and unchanged response; artifact: focused PostgreSQL transcript under .tasks/TASK-054-T3-FT-014-W4/.
constraints: Task & Follow-Up supplies only already-authorized Outcome source refs; Dataset Governance derives targets and owns locks/mutations.
Invocation occurs only for the created branch before commit; duplicate recovery performs zero association/event work.
invariants: The composed Outcome transaction is all-or-nothing across Task completion, Outcome, Outcome candidate, association, and required Timeline refs.
Association alone never changes lifecycle or can_train_on.
verification_targets: FT-014-AC-012: real PostgreSQL production-call matrix for photo/check-in/measurement/unsupported refs, multiple matches, terminal and zero match, exact retry/conflict, archive/revoke/concurrency, each failure insertion point, final row/event cardinality, and unchanged RecordOutcomeResultV1.
